eference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin; a non-member
gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirms that a project exists. The project's server map is not updatable her
e — see the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may

pjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revision is a capt
ure of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored
data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot…\n- [Get one server revision

iff two server revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md): Compares `from` (default: t
he revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools changed with the fields that move

il, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included — `hasClientSecret` reports presence only. A server id from anot
her project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/delete-a-saved-server.md): So
ft-deletes the server and schedules its cascade: MCP Apps views, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted secret objects, and a rotatio
n of every host config that referenced it. The cascade is ASYNCHRONOUS, so a read immediately after this call may still observe th

ver.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a clash). Editing a se

r group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only — there is no update route, b
ecause an editable group would reintroduce the drift that pinning exists to prevent. Names are unique per project, so a clash resp
onds `409`. Servers must…\n- [List a project's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-en
vironments.md): The project environments saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded unless `includeArchived=true` —

ronment.md): Create a project environment from a host plus, optionally, a standalone server group, a pinned skill selection, and p
inned plugin versions. The name must be unique among the project's live environments. Requires project admin.\n- [Check what this

riting to it.\n- [Update an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/update-an-environment.md): Edit an env
